description: This Java source file defines an EventAssertion class used for verifying the occurrence or absence of specific events within a messaging or event-driven system, primarily for testing purposes. It includes methods for asserting whether events are raised or not, extracting and verifying event data, and configuring assertions using a builder pattern.

classes.name: EventAssertion
classes.description: Main class providing methods to verify and assert events within tests, including builders for detailed assertions.

classes.name: EventAssertion.EventAssertionBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for making detailed assertions about specific event messages, such as verification of business date and data extraction.

classes.name: EventAssertion.EventDataAssertionBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for asserting equality or inequality of data extracted from events.

classes.name: EventAssertion.EventBigDecimalAssertionBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for asserting BigDecimal data values from events.

methods.name: assertEventRaised
methods.description: Asserts that an event of given class with specific ID has been raised within a timeout.

methods.name: assertEventNotRaised
methods.description: Asserts that an event of given class with specific ID has not been raised (or was not received) within a timeout.

methods.name: internalAssertEventRaised
methods.description: Internal method to check for an event's occurrence, with option to remove it if found.

methods.name: internalAssertEventNotRaised
methods.description: Internal method to verify an event was not received.

methods.name: assertEvent
methods.description: Returns an assertion builder for detailed assertions on a specific event.

methods.name: assertEventNotRaised
methods.description: Asserts that an event matching a predicate was not received.
